receção.consejo: According to the AO90, without «c» mute to «e».

texto: **Assinatura** is the section or handwritten signature at the end of the folio.
**Campo** is each box or blank space where a data is recorded.
If a box has no information, it is said that **está vazio** (is empty) or **falta** a data.
The person who attends to the public is usually in **receção** (reception, written without «p» muda according to the AO90).

frases.pt: Bom dia. Venho entregar a ficha de inscrição para o curso.
frases.es: Buenos días. Vengo a entregar la ficha de inscripción para el curso.
frases.en: Good morning. I'm here to deliver the registration card for the course.

frases.pt: Bom dia, dona Leonor. Deixe-me ver... O campo da morada está vazio.
frases.es: Buenos días, doña Leonor. Déjeme ver... El campo de la dirección está vacío.
frases.en: Good morning, Mrs. Leonor. Let me see... The direction field is empty.

frases.pt: Ah, tem razão! Falta escrever a rua e o código postal de Évora.
frases.es: ¡Ah, tiene razón! Falta escribir la calle y el código postal de Évora.
frases.en: Oh, he's right! The street and Evora's postal code are still to be written.

frases.pt: Exato. E lembre-se: a assinatura é obrigatória no fim da página.
frases.es: Exacto. Y recuerde: la firma es obligatoria al final de la página.
frases.en: Exactly. And remember, the signature is mandatory at the end of the page.
analisis: at the end of the page

frases.pt: Pronto! Já preenchi a morada e assinei o documento.
frases.es: ¡Listo! Ya completé la dirección y firmé el documento.
frases.en: Ready! I already completed the address and signed the document.

frases.pt: Muito obrigado. A sua inscrição está confirmada na receção.
frases.es: Muchas gracias. Su inscripción está confirmada en recepción.
frases.en: Thank you very much. Your registration is confirmed at reception.

bloques.pregunta: In a Portuguese administrative form, where is the «assinatura» normally located?

opciones.explicacion: The signature that confirms the procedure is placed at the bottom of the document.
At the beginning, only the institutional titles are listed.
The personal signature does not go over the outside of the envelope.

bloques.pregunta: If an official tells you «O campo está vazio», what is he pointing at you?

opciones.texto: That box has no data and you have to fill it in.
opciones.explicacion: It notes that the box is text-free and is still to be completed.

opciones.texto: That the procedure has been definitively cancelled
opciones.explicacion: It does not cancel the procedure, it only requests to correct the omitted data.

opciones.texto: That the office is closed for rest
opciones.explicacion: It refers to the folio box, not to the public care schedule.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the exact word that indicates signature.
bloques.frase: A ___ é obrigatória no fim da página.

opciones.explicacion: «Assinatura» is the legally required signature at the foot of the form.
«Cidade» means city and is not worth a contract.
«Cerveja» is beer and is completely inappropriate.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the right masculine adjective.
bloques.frase: O campo da morada está ___ ; falta escrever a rua.

opciones.explicacion: It matches «o campo» to indicate that it does not contain text.
It is feminine and would mean the opposite (full).
It does not describe the state of an administrative field.

bloques.pregunta: What is the faithful meaning of this phrase?
bloques.frase: Já preenchi a morada e assinei o documento.

opciones.texto: I already completed the address and signed the document.
opciones.explicacion: «Preenchi» is filled / completed and «assinei» is signed.

opciones.texto: I haven't been able to visit the hotel address yet.
opciones.explicacion: It does not express travel difficulties, but the completion of a form.

opciones.texto: I forgot to take the document to the working table.
opciones.explicacion: The sentence confirms that the document has been completed and signed.

bloques.pregunta: What procedure did Thomas finally use at the window?

opciones.texto: Confirma a inscrição completa na receção
opciones.explicacion: Valid and confirm registration after filling out the missing data and receiving the signature.

opciones.texto: Pede uma refeição quente para o almoço
Solicita um táxi para ir ao aeroporto
opciones.explicacion: It has no connection to the transport.

bloques.frase: A assinatura é obrigatória na página
bloques.traduccion: The signature is mandatory on the page
bloques.explicacion: The + signature is + mandatory + on the + page.

intro: When submitting proceedings to a counter in Portugal, officials check that no mandatory field is missing before the signature («assinatura»).
